messages:
jamie: main CI red on linux-e2e-serial (job 7823) — failing one test: tests/serving/test_kv_prefill.py::test_prefill_oom with HTTP 502 from model-proxy. Anyone seen this? <https://ci.redwood.com/job/7823|job/7823>

sasha: saw a pod restart spike earlier, infra alert showed restarts for model-proxy :eyes:

matt: logs show ConnectionResetError / 502 from proxy, suspect grpc-proxy pin in PR #3124 or a transient network blip

infra-bot: rerun queued: job 7823 (rerun #1) — triggered by jamie

jamie: thanks, can someone grab last-green for that job?

olivia: last-green tool shows commit c3f12a9 at 2034500000 was green

sasha: can we bisect between c3f12a9 and HEAD? suspect deps bump (3124) or kv-cache tweak (3130)

matt: i'll kick off a quick local bisect on a reduced repro, may take a few mins

ci-bot: rerun finished: job 7823 — still red, same 502

jamie: rerun didn't help. matt any luck with the bisect?

matt: narrowed it to PR 3124 (grpc-proxy pin). tests pass on c3f12a9, fail on merge including 3124

sasha: can we revert 3124 on main to unblock the pipeline? prefer a revert PR rather than force-push

jamie: @ops can we get a revert PR and short rollback window? want to avoid breaking release lanes

infra-bot: creating revert PR from merge commit abcdef — <https://repo.redwood.com/revert/3124|revert/3124>

olivia: +1 to revert, i'll also open a follow-up to harden proxy backoff and add retries in the harness

matt: i'll validate the revert locally and trigger a canary pipeline once the revert PR is up

ci-bot: canary pipeline (job 7830) queued by matt

jamie: if revert is green we should merge revert, cut hotfix branch, and then re-evaluate other merges

sasha: noted, i'll monitor the matrix and escalate if flakes rise :thumbsup:

matt: quick follow-up idea: add guarded retry on 502 in the e2e harness; but revert first

jamie: will keep thread updated. if canary passes we merge revert and rerun full matrix

matt: canary passed — job 7830 green

infra-bot: revert PR merged by ops

jamie: main CI back to green on next run. thanks team :tada:
